references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, the seventy elders were chosen to meet Moses at the tabernacle. Verse 30 shows that Moses and these elders returned together to the camp after the Spirit of the Lord had come upon them.
Moses had gathered the seventy elders around the tabernacle, and the Spirit came upon them. Verse 30 describes their return to the camp following this spiritual experience.
Moses appointed leaders and elders to help him lead the people, which forms the background for the elders mentioned together with Moses in this text.
Moses and the elders of Israel are mentioned together as they go up to the Lord, a pattern repeated in Numbers 11:30 where Moses and the elders act as one.
